lines: # Ephemeral Lattice runtime state — not part of the durable board.
# The board (tasks/ events/ plans/ artifacts/ ids.json config.json)
# stays tracked: it is the audit log and cross-machine coordination
# state. The paths below are mutated constantly and must never
# diverge per-worktree or collide on merge.

descriptions.backlog: Task is captured but no work has started. No planning, no implementation.
descriptions.blocked: Work cannot proceed due to an external dependency or unresolved issue.
descriptions.cancelled: Work has been abandoned. No further action will be taken.
descriptions.done: Work is reviewed, merged, and shipped. No further action needed.
descriptions.in_planning: Design, dialogue, and scoping underway. No implementation code should be written yet.
descriptions.in_progress: Implementation is actively underway. Code is being written, tested, or integrated.
descriptions.in_validation: End-to-end validation is underway. The change is being exercised against a running system — browser automation, simulator flows, curl — before the PR opens. The bar: 'I saw it work,' not 'I think it should work.'
descriptions.planned: Plan is written and approved. Ready for implementation but work has not started.
descriptions.pr_open: PR is open and awaiting human review, CI, or merge. Local review and validation artifacts are recorded.
descriptions.review: Local review is underway. A review sub-agent is examining the diff before validation begins.
